notes: Placed together with jiangsu-suzhou and jiangsu-changzhou. Wuxi city plus its Lake Tai shore (Lingshan, Turtle Head Island, Binhu) is one destination (21 spots). Yixing (7 kept spots, own Wikivoyage article) and Jiangyin (6 kept, own Wikivoyage article) are separate county-level cities 45-60 km away and are proposed as new destinations, not Wuxi spots. Lake Tai is a standalone spot (shared with Suzhou). Nianhua Bay/Lingshan, Xihui Park/Jichang Garden/Huishan Ancient Town/Taibo Temple and Lihu Park/Liyuan Garden overlap as the skeptic noted; all were kept, none is a wrapper town around its own attraction except Huishan Ancient Town, which is a street district with its own draws. Provisional destinations (no coordinates) are flagged.
